value: SMN1 g.27134T>G (rs143838139): present, 5 of 60 reads carry G at the SMN1 and SMN2 copies of the site together (about 0.3 of the 4 SMN1 and SMN2 copies). The reads cannot tell whether a G sits on SMN1 or SMN2. With two SMN1 copies, this marker goes with a higher chance that both sit on one chromosome (2+0, a silent carrier): in Luo 2014 it raised the residual carrier risk of a two-copy result (in African Americans from about 1 in 121 to 1 in 34); the figures depend on ancestry. This marker does not prove 2+0, and its absence does not rule 2+0 out.
